set.approach: Start at Old Man of the Mountain Historic Site, then hike the Greenleaf Trail up toward the AMC hut. Where the trail flattens, shortly before Eagle Pass, a small cairn on the left marks the start of a climbers' trail that heads uphill. Follow the climbers' trail, bearing left at every fork and staying left in the trees rather than going into the talus field on the right, to reach the Main Wall. The start is at the right-hand end of the stone patio, inside a short chimney. You can also reach the first-pitch anchor by walking the Right Flank ledge.
set.descent_text: Lower from the anchors. The wall's pitches are long, and a long rope is needed to reach the ground.

review.notes: Area page: approach, long pitches that need a long rope to lower. Route page: start location, rope just reaches the ground from the P2 anchor. Rope length left out of the text.

set.approach: Start at Old Man of the Mountain Historic Site, then hike the Greenleaf Trail up toward the AMC hut. Where the trail flattens, shortly before Eagle Pass, a small cairn on the left marks the start of a climbers' trail that heads uphill. Follow the climbers' trail, bearing left at every fork and staying left in the trees rather than going into the talus field on the right, to reach the Main Wall. It is the overhanging sport line next to Farewell Angelina, with Pin It To Win It on its other side, left of a birch tree where the trail levels off.
set.descent_text: Lower off the anchor at the top of the bolts.

review.notes: Area page: approach; route page: location by birch tree, bolts to a lower-off anchor.

set.approach: Start at Old Man of the Mountain Historic Site, then hike the Greenleaf Trail up toward the AMC hut. Where the trail flattens, shortly before Eagle Pass, a small cairn on the left marks the start of a climbers' trail that heads uphill. Follow the climbers' trail a short way, take the right at the first fork, and follow that a very short way to reach the steep bolted wall of the Dog House. This route is the leftmost one at the crag and starts off a low rock step; the first bolts are over chossy rock, so a stick clip helps.

review.notes: Area page: approach and stick-clip note; route page: leftmost route, starts off a rock step. No descent stated.
